subject: Cross-border invoice split & portal enrollment (Aurelia Corp)
messages:
From: Marco Ricci <m.ricci@aureliacorp.com>
To: vendor-requests@redwoodinference.com
Cc: Aurelia Billing <billing@aureliacorp.com>
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 14:12:00 +0200
Subject: New vendor registration + split invoicing for EU sales

Hi team,

We're bringing Redwood Inference into Aurelia's supplier master for an upcoming engagement. Two items to confirm before we kick off portal invites:

1) We need Redwood's legal name, VAT IDs (if you have an EU branch), and a primary remit bank account to seed the portal. Aurelia requires separate remit instructions for payments originating from our EU entity (Aurelia EU Srl) vs. our US entity — effectively a split invoicing flow so that EU sales invoices carry the EU VAT details and the US sales invoices use the US remit.

2) Aurelia's procurement team will send a portal invite (ProcurePay) and expects a completed AP onboarding packet with tax docs and a sample invoice in UBL or XML. Can you confirm whether Redwood prefers:
   - Self-billing by Aurelia EU (we generate the invoice and remit to your account), or
   - Standard vendor invoice with PO reference and split remit instructions?

If you can share your onboarding packet and a sample invoice (UBL/XML or PDF) we can pre-populate the vendor record and speed the invite. Also let us know the canonical PO field Redwood requires (PO number position, buyer legal name, any required line-item tags).

Thanks — aim is to have you enrolled before our pilot kicks off in early July.

Best,
Marco
Procurement Lead — Aurelia Corp

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marco Ricci <m.ricci@aureliacorp.com>, Aurelia Billing <billing@aureliacorp.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com, marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 16:02:00 +0200
Subject: Re: New vendor registration + split invoicing for EU sales

Hi Marco — thanks for the clear note. We're happy to get this enrolled ahead of your pilot. Quick answers up front:

- Preferred approach: we generally prefer "Standard vendor invoice with PO reference and split remit instructions." We can support self-billing for EU where required, but prefer the PO + vendor invoice flow so our accounting systems (and tax reporting) keep consistent records.
- I'll attach our AP onboarding packet and a sample XML invoice for ProcurePay population.

Marcus (Finance) — can you confirm the legal entity cadence below and provide VAT/IBAN for the EU branch? Also confirm whether we need to accept Aurelia's self-bill T&Cs to enable self-billing (we can, but need legal review).

Marco — please go ahead and send the ProcurePay invite to vendor@redwoodinference.com once your team has the pre-populated fields. If ProcurePay provides a tenant id or vendor token, include it in the invite; that helps our team map the incoming connection.

Attachments: AP_Onboarding_Packet_Aurelia_v2.pdf, PO_Sample_Invoice.xml

Thanks,
Olga Petrov
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Marcus / Laura —

Forwarding Aurelia's request. Key asks for finance/legal:
- Confirm our canonical legal name(s) and VAT/TIN values for both US and EU entities.
- Provide EU IBAN, SWIFT, and payment instruction text for the "Aurelia EU Srl" remit path.
- Confirm whether we can accept Aurelia's self-bill for EU sales (they offered to self-bill). If not, list what additional paperwork legal needs.
- PO mapping: Aurelia asked which PO field we require for automated matching. We generally match on PO number (root), buyer GL code must be present in the line item meta if available, and they should include our vendor ID (we'll assign once registered).

I've attached the onboarding packet (pdf) and an example UBL/xml invoice (for ProcurePay). Please reply with the values I can copy back to Marco.

Thanks — timeline: they want this enrolled before the pilot week (starting 05 Jul).

Olga
